definitions.explanation: An introductory-level resource or course for learning something new. Commonly used in book titles and course names.

definitions.gloss: becoming a disciple, entering a school
definitions.explanation: Formally becoming a student or disciple under a master, especially in traditional arts, martial arts, or crafts.

examples.japanese: ⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought an introductory book on programming.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け→初心者向け：17934_shoshinshamuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧です。
examples.english: This class is a beginner-level introductory course.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テキスト→テキスト：01469_tekisuto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦わかりやすい→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧。
examples.english: As an introductory Japanese textbook, this one is the easiest to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Become a disciple of a master.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I entered the school of a tea ceremony teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{落語家|らくごか}→落語家：28498_rakugoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I became a disciple of a famous rakugo performer and began my training.

notes:
Sense 1 is by far the more common usage in modern Japanese, appearing frequently in book titles and course names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{入門|にゅうもん} (introduction to ~, as a book/course title suffix)
- {入門|にゅうもん}{書|しょ} (introductory book)
- {入門|にゅうもん}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧ (introductory course)
- {入門|にゅうもん}{編|へん} (introductory volume/section)
- ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入門|にゅうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (become a master's disciple)

Sense 2 is used in traditional arts such as ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ (comic storytelling), ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony), ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ (calligraphy), and ⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧ (martial arts).
